meaning:
στίγμα -τος, τό
(στίζω, to prick), [in LXX: Sng.1:11 (נְקֻדָּה) * ;]
a tattoed mark or brand: τὰ σ. τοῦ Ἰησοῦ, Gal.6:17 (see Lft., in l; Deiss., BS, 349; LAE, 303; MM, xxiii).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.
